name: Genatrix interface API
rules: An interface runs in the shell's sandboxed frame and reaches the core only through the shell: post {t: 'call', id, method, path, body} to the parent window and wait for {t: 'result', id, ok, status, body}.
Everything here is read with GET and changes nothing. What a device reads here it could read before.
Lists answer {rows, next}. When next is not null, pass it back as the parameter the endpoint names (before or after) for the next page.
Fields and endpoints are added, never changed or removed. Ignore fields you do not know.
Times are RFC 3339. Ids are opaque strings.

Writing is through the endpoints the built-in interface uses; the shell decides about each (web/src/lib/gate.ts): reading and drafting pass, lasting changes are confirmed in the shell, approvals happen only in the shell.

messages_to_shell.call: {t:'call', id, method, path, body}: a request to the core, answered with {t:'result', id, ok, status, body}
messages_to_shell.review: {t:'review', id, action}: open an action for the user's decision in the shell; answered with the action as it stands after
messages_to_shell.nav: {t:'nav', path, replace}: the interface moved to path; the shell puts it in the address bar
messages_to_shell.open: {t:'open', url, download}: open a link elsewhere, or download from the core; the shell shows where first
messages_to_shell.panel: {t:'panel', panel}: open the shell's own panel: security, interface or pair
messages_to_shell.store: {t:'store', key, value}: keep a small string for this device (value null forgets it); handed back in the frame address as ?s=<base64 JSON>

messages_from_shell.result: the answer to a call or review
messages_from_shell.route: {t:'route', path}: the user went back or forward; show path

shell.start: The frame's address is /ui/<hash>/index.html?s=<kept strings>#<path>; start on <path>.
